source.scope: Committed integrated baseline. Later P00 documentation/version edits are intentionally outside this snapshot.

evidence.method: Source inspection, pure data-module imports, exact Git blob SHA-256/length verification, manifest verification. No gameplay/browser/controller/touch/hardware test is claimed by this inventory.
reproduction: Read all listed files from source.commit with git show <commit>:<path>.
SHA-256 file bytes; canonical record hashes use game/data-json.mjs canonicalJSON UTF-8.
Enumerate campaign.json; active/archive/optional catalogue paths; SOURCE_EXTERNAL_EDITIONS; COOP_STARTER_PACK.
Compare all manifest.files hashes and lengths against committed compiled files.
Enumerate tracked game/site/authoring HTML routes and dialog IDs.
limitations: Player-installed content is variable and not inventoried from a personal browser profile. Published source candidates and the runtime import/consumer paths are enumerated.
Source-described procedural art is not marked missing. Approval quality and live visual consistency require P08-A visual checks.
Screenshot/device/performance and public-byte evidence belong in separate phase evidence, not inferred from this file.
